title: JA Vega wp7: portfolio project pages, theme toggle, touch menu, Admin author, footer newsletter and source-CMS wording behave like the source
steps: S1: A WordPress site running the wp-ja-vega theme under test (local stand from the quickstart pack) and the Joomla source (local stand from quickstart/ja-vega/j6).

S2: From the TCH checkout run: node tasks/ja-vega-wp7/tools/measure116.mjs --site <site> --source <source> --out <dir> (add --zip <theme.zip> --record <BROWSER.json> to bind the run to the theme bytes).
S3: Read the final line and each PASS/FAIL line.
expect: project: the three audited portfolio pages show the source's sections in order, in light and dark at 390, 768, 1024, 1180 and 1440 (30 pages).
theme: every click on the theme toggle flips the visible theme, the first one too and on a phone too.
touch: at 1024 and 1180 the first tap on Our Services or Portfolio opens its panel and keeps the URL; the second tap navigates.
author, newsletter, wording, coverage: each PASS with an empty problems list.
evidence: Independent audit 03/10/2026; measure116 7/7 on 1.1.6 bound to wp-ja-vega-1.1.6.zip ca887dac (tasks/ja-vega-wp7/release/BROWSER.json)
fence: Browser-measured behaviour of the shipped theme against the source; the tool fails closed on a crash
